tips.text: Level it in a squad on a high enemy count mission; Elite Sanctuary Onslaught is the best affinity farm once unlocked.
Buy it with credits, rank it to 30, then sell it back for 2,500 credits.
Check the equipment tab in your profile to see whether it already counts as mastered.
Do not count Forma as a Mastery source here; re-ranking after a Forma earns nothing new.
Buy it the moment you have 15,000 credits; it is a weak gun that exists to be ranked for Mastery.
